Our Background

Eight Years of Solving Healthcare Challenges

Digha Biomedical is a division of Digha Mux Limited — incorporated in Nigeria as a Technological Innovation and Inventing Company. We don't just supply medical equipment. We design it, manufacture it, install it, and keep it running.

For over eight years, we have been a reliable, low-cost pillar for hospitals across Nigeria — providing ready and dependable alternatives to equipment deficiencies and sudden breakdowns that would otherwise halt patient care entirely.

Partnering with Digha Biomedical means increased return on investment while ensuring hospitals continue to deliver adequate health services to the Nigerian public. Our products are ISO 9001:2000 certified and built to last.

How We Got Here

Our Journey

Founded
Digha Mux Limited Incorporated

Incorporated in Nigeria as a Technological Innovation and Inventing Company with a bold mission — to solve medical equipment challenges facing Nigerian hospitals at a price they can afford.

Early Years
First Hospital Partnerships

Began supplying and servicing X-ray equipment to hospitals in Anambra State — including Our Lady of Lourdes Ihiala and Toronto Hospital Onitsha — building a reputation for reliability and speed.

Growth Phase
Manufacturing Our Own Equipment

Launched in-house manufacturing of the DMX-650 X-ray Console, DM-B3 Ray-Combiner, hybrid solar pump controllers and electronic circuit boards — all ISO 9001:2000 certified. Digha became a maker, not just a supplier.

Expansion
National Reach — Abuja & Federal Hospitals

Expanded client base to federal hospitals and military medical centers including 82 Division Medical Center Enugu and NAOWA Hospital Asokoro, Abuja — proving local engineering can meet national standards.

Training
Capacity Building & Engineering Training

Partnered with MedShare, Coca-Cola Foundation and Anambra State Government to deliver hands-on biomedical engineering training — 75% practical — for the next generation of Nigerian engineers.

Today
8+ Years & Still Building

Serving 20+ hospitals across Nigeria with locally-manufactured biomedical equipment, ongoing maintenance, engineering training and hospital partnerships. The best is still ahead.

Engineering Training Programs
Hands-on sessions with the next generation of Nigerian engineers
Field Installation & Repair
Our engineers work directly inside hospital radiology rooms
Hospital Partnerships
Delivering and demonstrating equipment at partner hospitals
